airflow.note: HIM R6.9: a vertically mounted FX-4 needs its mount kit's baffles "to meet NEBS preferred airflow specifications (air flows in the front, and out the rear of the shelf)". For the horizontal installation drawn here the fan unit sits at the right-hand end and the air crosses the cards; the direction is not stated in any staged document, so no airflow is declared.

chassis.note: 3HH90279AAAATQZZA23 s8.5.2: width 447 mm, overall over flanges 481 mm, mounting centre distance 465 mm, depth 278.3 mm, height 221.9 mm; s8.5.3 weight 8.6 kg including the fan. The BA data sheet prints 447 / 480.5 / 465 / 278.6 / 221.9, and its own drawing labels the body 445.5. The body modelled is the 447 between the flange folds; the flanges (ears) are not drawn, per the method, and their extent is (481 - 447) / 2 = 17 mm a side.

columns.note: Across: the GFC's face runs 7.6 to 414.4 on the drawing (outer strokes, 406.8 = 405 to the stroke), centre 211.0, so every 405 mm card starts at x 8.5 and ends at 413.5. The 8.5 mm strip at the left carries the card guides and latches. The fan column runs from 413.6 to the body edge; BFAN-X is 33.1 wide (UDS p386), which closes it at 446.7, and its top at y 4.2 is where the fan column's top line sits on the drawing (3.2 to 4.7).

defaults.note: The default build is one FANT-H BB in NT A, the NT dummy in NT B, the dummy in NTIO and in all four LT slots, the NGFC-G and the BFAN-X. A shelf is never shipped with open slots - the dummies exist for airflow and EMC - and FANT-H BB is the current ANSI NT. The configurations below carry the other NT arrangements.

ground.note: HIM R6.9 Figure 173 "Grounding cable connection on 7360 ISAM FX-4" (p297) points to the ground cable connector on the RIGHT side of the shelf, about mid-height and a little behind the front, and Procedure 59 routes the cable "to the right side of the shelf and up to the middle". The figure is a perspective view, so the position (x 22, centred at y 111) is estimated from it and the lug is drawn with common/ground-lug@1; the connector itself is a dual-hole lug seat for a 4 AWG lug with 1/4 in holes at 3/4 in spacing (HIM text before Figure 173).

ground-pair.note: THE CONNECTOR IS ONE PAIR (#828, #830): common/ground-stud-pair-3-4-1-4@1, two 1/4 in. (1/4-20) pan-head screws at exactly 19.05, the stud-pair-3-4 interface's pitch, the 3/4 in. spacing of the dual-hole lug the HIM names. Placed at rotate 90, one screw above the other, because Figure 173 draws the connector's two studs stacked in its callout box; centred where the single common/ground-lug@1 stood for the pair. The screw size is the lug's 1/4 in. hole, not a stated stud. The position stays the estimate of the ground note.

ground-stud-size.note: HIM R6.9 s14.3.1 gives the lug of each grounding cable connector of the FX-4 as a 4 AWG dual-hole lug with 1/4 in. holes at 3/4 in. spacing: the `stud-size` of ground, read from the holes of the lug the guide calls for. The placement is the pair.

model.note: 3HH90279AAAATQZZA23 s8.5 heads the chapter "NFXS-F BB - FX-4 shelf" (ANSI); the BA build is the R4.x-R5.x edition and its data sheet draws the same elevation, line for line, which is why its vector copy can stand in for the BB's raster one. That BA and BB share a front is read off the two figures, not stated.

nt-occupants.note: 3HH90279AAAATQZZA23 and the ANSI UDS R6.9 list FANT-F, FANT-G, FANT-H (BB and the 125 W BC) and FANT-M (BA/BB) as NT boards for the ANSI FX-4. The ANSI FANT-F (BC/BD/BF, nokia/fant-f-bd@1) and FANT-G BA (nokia/fant-g-ba@1) are accepted. The ETSI builds (FANT-H AA/AC, nokia/fant-m-etsi@1) belong to the ETSI shelves and are not accepted here. The second NT slot takes the NT dummy 3FE65651AA when a single NT is fitted (UDS s12.3/12.4 - it "must be mounted in the slot position of the second NT board").

ntio-occupants.note: FNIO-A, FNIO-B, FNIO-D and FNIO-E seat in the NTIO slot; the LT/NTIO dummy 3FE65651BA closes it when no NT I/O card is fitted.

orientation.note: Cards are modelled upright in their own contracts and turned here with `rotate: 270`, so the card's top end (ejector lever, lamps, the NT port housings) lies at the LEFT, toward the NGFC-G power terminals. Taken from the FX-8, which shares this layout (GFC along the bottom with its terminal block at the left, fan column at the right): lab photographs of an installed NFXS-E (2026-09-24) show a FANT-H's lever and lamps directly beside the terminal cover. No photograph of an FX-4 is staged, and Figure 4 cannot say - it draws the card rows as generic grids with a latch at each end. An earlier revision seated the cards at `rotate: 90`, 180 degrees out. The NGFC-G (which only ever lies flat) is authored as it sits and is not rotated.

panel-scale.note: Gate 1. The BA Figure 4 front view rendered at 1200 dpi: the body is 3120 px between its fold lines and 1559 px from top edge to bottom edge. 3120 / 447 = 6.98 px/mm across and 1559 / 221.9 = 7.03 down, 0.7 percent apart - and 0.3 percent apart against the drawing's own labelled 445.5, so the figure is orthographic and every position below is a measurement at about 0.15 mm/px, limited in practice by the drawing's 1 mm double edge strokes. The BB raster Figure 44 (150 ppi, 0.867 px/mm) was measured first and agrees to a pixel, which is 1.2 mm, and no better.

power.note: The shelf itself draws nothing: every consumer is a card with its own `power-draw-max-w` (from the Safety Manuals) and the fan unit's. The shelf is powered through the NGFC-G's -48 V DC terminals. No shelf-level power envelope is stated in any staged document; searched the UDS chapter 8, HIM R6.9 chapter 14.5 "Power cabling" and the Safety Manual 3HH12894 tables.

right-vents.note: Figure 173 draws the right side perforated over roughly its rear half, full height inside a margin; the field is placed at x 128 to 270 and y 12 to 210 by eye from that perspective view. Hole size and pitch are not documented.

rows.note: Card rows read off Figure 4 along the right-hand ejector column and the left latch column, then set to the vendor's stated pitches (UDS s8.4.1 "NT cards: 30 mm, NTIO card: 25 mm, LT cards: 25 mm"). Measured LT row edges 6.45 / 31.4 / 56.4 / 81.2 / 106.0 (pitch 24.9), so LT4 starts at 6.4 and LT1 ends at 106.4. A rail runs across the shelf between LT1 and NT B. The GFC takes the bottom 28.8 mm (the face nokia/ngfc-g@1 measured on this same figure, top line to the shelf's bottom edge), so it starts at 193.1, and the NT rows are stacked up from it at their pitches: NT A 163.1, NTIO 138.1, NT B 108.1, leaving the rail 106.4 to 108.1. The drawing puts the NT row edges at 110.2 / 139.7 / 164.8 / 194.5 - within 1.5 mm, the NT A bottom edge being where the figure and the GFC's own measured height disagree by 1.4 mm. The GFC's measured face was held and the difference taken up in the rail, because the GFC height is corroborated by a second drawing (its own front panel) and the rail is not.

slot-legends.note: The slot legends (NTA, NTIO, NTB, 01 to 04) and the shelf name are printed on the fan cover, not on the frame - see nokia/fan-cover-fx4@1 - so the frame itself carries no silkscreen in this model. Figure 4 draws no printing anywhere else on the front frame.
